characters.summary: Hal Jordan relies on his Green Lantern power ring to construct virtually any weapon or device imaginable through sheer willpower. He engages opponents in ranged and melee combat while maintaining protective energy fields and high-speed flight.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to yellow color impurity (historical depending on era)
Ring requires periodic recharging via power battery
limitations: Power ring charge lasts 24 hours standard and depletes with intensive construct usage
Requires conscious willpower and focus to maintain constructs

sources.supports: General character abilities, history, and Green Lantern ring mechanics.

feats.claim: Created complex hard-light machinery and heavy ordinance during combat patrols.

campaignTags.claim: Hal Jordan uses his power ring for self-propelled flight across planetary and interstellar distances.
The Green Lantern ring functions as a versatile tool generating hard-light technological constructs.

unknowns: Extent of ring capabilities during timeline retcons regarding the yellow impurity and Parallax entity influence.

characters.continuity: DC Comics (Day of Judgment / Modern Era)
characters.summary: Bound to the divine Spirit of Vengeance, Hal Jordan wields near-limitless cosmic and divine power capable of altering reality, manipulating matter, and passing judgment on sinners.
weaknesses: Requires a human host to channel his full power and act effectively
Subject to divine mandates and restrictions
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the Green Lantern ring with the divine cosmic might of the Spectre, elevating power levels to reality-warping and divine judgment status.

sources.supports: Spectre host bond, divine powers, and reality-altering capabilities.

unknowns: Exact limitations of Hal Jordan's control over the Spectre entity compared to other hosts.

characters.summary: Harley Quinn fights using acrobatic agility, a mallet, firearms, and unpredictable melee tactics. She frequently leverages improvised weaponry and high pain tolerance.

mechanisms: Enhanced durability and immunity to various toxins via Poison Ivy's serum

weaknesses: Relies primarily on physical gear and human endurance without superhuman physical strength
Psychologically volatile
limitations: Limited to standard human physical strength without heavy weapons

sources.supports: Abilities, weapons, agility, and toxin resistance.

feats.claim: Engaged armed guards in close quarters using gymnastics and a mallet.

campaignTags.claim: Enhanced healing properties from Poison Ivy's toxin immunity serum.

characters.summary: Hawkgirl uses Nth metal wings for flight and fights with melee weapons such as maces and swords, possessing enhanced strength and durability from her alien physiology.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to specific anti-Nth metal or high-tier cosmic suppression
Relies heavily on close-quarters combat
limitations: Flight speed limited to wing-propelled velocity

sources.supports: Nth metal properties, flight, strength, and weapon usage.

feats.claim: Flew in combat and engaged superpowered opponents with an Nth metal mace.

campaignTags.claim: Wings powered by Nth metal grant natural flight capabilities.

characters.summary: Hawkman engages in brutal close-quarters combat utilizing ancient weapons, Nth metal flight harness wings, and centuries of reincarnated tactical experience.
weaknesses: Prone to berserker rage during combat
Vulnerable to anti-Nth metal dampeners

sources.supports: Nth metal abilities, weapons, reincarnation background.

feats.claim: Survived severe trauma and regenerated via Nth metal properties.

campaignTags.claim: Nth metal wings allow winged flight.
Nth metal grants accelerated healing from wounds.

characters.summary: Huntress is a street-level vigilante who fights using crossbows, firearms, staff weapons, and martial arts, relying on tactical stealth and aggressive offense.
weaknesses: Human physical limits
Prone to lethal force methods which conflict with allies

sources.supports: Weapons, martial arts background, and vigilante tactics.

feats.claim: Infiltrated enemy strongholds and subdued guards using crossbow and martial arts.

campaignTags.claim: Employs vigilante stealth and urban infiltration techniques.
Uses crossbows, grappling hooks, and specialized tactical gear.

characters.summary: John Constantine is a master occultist and con artist who defeats powerful supernatural entities through quick thinking, trickery, protective circles, and esoteric magic rather than raw firepower.
weaknesses: Physically fragile human body
Heavy chain smoker with compromised lung health
limitations: Relies on preparation and knowledge rather than direct physical combat prowess

sources.supports: Occult knowledge, magic abilities, and con artist fighting style.

feats.claim: Outsmarted and banished high-ranking demons through strategic deception and ritual magic.

campaignTags.claim: Performs esoteric rituals, spells, and magic wards.
Casts spells to bind demons and banish supernatural entities.

characters.summary: The Joker is an unpredictable criminal mastermind who fights using lethal gag items, toxin gas, firearms, and ruthless psychological warfare.
weaknesses: Normal human physical conditioning
Mental instability leads to erratic tactical errors

sources.supports: Joker venom, weapons, and criminal tactics.

feats.claim: Subdued crowds using aerosolized Joker venom.

campaignTags.claim: Deploys customized lethal gag weaponry and chemical toxins.

characters.summary: Having stolen nearly 99 percent of Mister Mxyzptlk's fifth-dimensional reality-warping power, Emperor Joker possesses godlike omnipotence, able to reshape the universe on a whim.
weaknesses: Obsession with Batman prevents him from stabilizing his own reality completely
Power source can be extracted by fifth-dimensional magic experts
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard human Joker gear and physical limits with fifth-dimensional godlike reality-warping powers.

sources.supports: Fifth-dimensional power theft from Mxyzptlk and reality-warping feats.

unknowns: Full extent of the stolen power compared to the genuine full might of Mister Mxyzptlk.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Era (Superman: Son of Kal-El)
characters.summary: Jon Kent inherits kryptonian physiology granting him flight, super strength, invulnerability, heat vision, and solar flare energy discharge, augmented by half-human empathy.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to kryptonite
Vulnerability to red solar radiation
limitations: Powers depend on absorption of yellow sunlight

sources.supports: Kryptonian powers, half-human heritage, and abilities as Superman.

feats.claim: Flew across atmosphere and restrained heavy machinery using super-strength.

unknowns: Full capacity of his hybrid physiology compared to his father Kal-El at peak age.
